headline: Names a post office building in Floresville, Texas, the "Floresville Veterans Post Office Building."
what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility at 141 Paloma Drive in Floresville, Texas. The building is now officially called the "Floresville Veterans Post Office Building." It is a ceremonial change and does not alter postal services, rules, or funding.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 20, 2015.
